station_identity.profession: Contrarian at Floors (EXTREME_FEAR=floor) + Inertia Engine at Ceilings

tier_methodology.EVENT: N < 10. Historical record of individual significance. No composite EV weight. Active in alert channel.
tier_methodology.TRANSITIONAL: 10 <= N < 30. Direction reliable, magnitude uncertain. Composite weight 0.5.
tier_methodology.CONFIRMED: N >= 30, D1 extreme (bins 0,1,4,5). Robust statistics. Composite weight 1.0.
tier_methodology.BASELINE: N >= 30, D1 central (bins 2,3). Ordinary market weather. Composite weight 1.0.

_documentation.model_purpose: METAR Station FG Empirical Fact Store 2: Triad Timing & Multi-Scale Dual-Passage Engine. Evaluates every observed state triad (D1__D2__D3) across its official continuous market history (2011-02-01 to 2026-09-03, 3921 daily trading bars) without directional bias. Measures exact temporal turning-point timing (6-slot canonical geometry [t-2..t+2, ENTRE]) and forward Triple-Barrier first-passage returns independently for both market bottoms (MIN) and market tops (MAX). Pure empirical measurement data with zero narrative or qualitative judgment.
_documentation.return_formula: First-Passage Triple Barrier: from episode start bar t0, walk forward bar-by-bar. UP_barrier = P0 * (1 + scale), DN_barrier = P0 * (1 - scale). hit_MIN = {UP barrier hit before DN barrier}; favorable_MIN = (P_end - P0) / P0. hit_MAX = {DN barrier hit before UP barrier}; favorable_MAX = (P0 - P_end) / P0. Time-stop vertical barrier calibrated to P95 empirical resolution: zz25->35, zz50->110, zz75->190 bars. Unresolved episodes at timeout are counted as failures (hit=False) to eliminate survivorship bias.

state_hierarchy.L1_D1: Point-in-Time Magnitude (Level mapped to 6 Gaussian sigma bins [0..5])
state_hierarchy.L2_D2: 72h Kinematic Velocity (3-day difference mapped to 5 Gaussian bins [0..4])
state_hierarchy.L3_D3: Intra-Station Volatility Instability Ratio (std(2d)/std(10d) mapped to 5 Gaussian bins [0..4])

zz25.operational_horizon: Tactical Swing / Short-term turning point capture.

zz50.operational_horizon: Intermediate Cyclical Swing / Core leg accumulation.

zz75.operational_horizon: Structural Macro Leg / Long-term regime trend.

poblacion.barras: Total active daily bars where triad condition held true within valid era.
poblacion.n_episodios: Count of discrete de-clustered continuous episodes.
poblacion.duracion_media: Mean episode duration in consecutive trading days.
poblacion.duracion_max: Maximum observed consecutive episode duration in days.

overflows.n_episodios_tier_gte_1: Episodes where indicator breached +/-3 sigma on any dimension during episode.
overflows.pct_episodios_overflow: Percentage of triad episodes reaching Tier 1 or higher.
overflows.max_tier_d1: Highest observed overflow tier on D1 Level (0=Normal, 1=T1, 2=T2, 3=T3, 4=T4, 5=T5).
overflows.max_tier_d2: Highest observed overflow tier on D2 3d Velocity.
overflows.max_tier_d3: Highest observed overflow tier on D3 Volatility Instability.

resumen_rango.n_en_rango: Episodes occurring within [-2, +2] trading bars of target ZigZag turning point.
resumen_rango.pct_en_rango: Percentage of episodes falling within the turning point proximity window.
resumen_rango.delta_medio: Mean absolute distance in trading bars to nearest target pivot.
resumen_rango.delta_mediana: Median absolute distance in trading bars to nearest target pivot.

slots_zz25.n: Episode sample count in this specific timing slot.
slots_zz25.pct: Percentage of triad episodes falling into this timing slot.
slots_zz25.hit_rate: Empirical win rate at zz25 (2.5%) scale for episodes in this slot.
slots_zz25.ev: Expected arithmetic return of the first-passage resolution at zz25 from this slot.
slots_zz25.bars: Mean trading bars required to resolve the position at zz25 from this slot.

first_passage.hit_rate: Empirical barrier touch win rate across all episodes for this scale.
first_passage.baseline_hit: Unconditional market win rate for (blanco, scale) during this station's valid era.
first_passage.hit_neto: hit_rate - baseline_hit (empirical edge over unconditional baseline).
first_passage.ev: Expected arithmetic mean return per trade (positive = capital expansion).
first_passage.baseline_ev: Unconditional market expected return during this station's valid era.
first_passage.profit_factor: Gross profit sum divided by absolute gross loss sum.
first_passage.ev_por_barra: ev / bars_medio (capital velocity: return edge per unit of holding time).
first_passage.mae_medio: Mean Maximum Adverse Excursion (average drawdown pain).
first_passage.mae_p90: 90th percentile Maximum Adverse Excursion (severe tail risk pain).
first_passage.mfe_medio: Mean Maximum Favorable Excursion (average peak unrealized profit).
first_passage.mfe_p90: 90th percentile Maximum Favorable Excursion (tail profit potential).
first_passage.bars_medio: Mean holding bars from signal trigger to barrier event or timeout.
first_passage.p_value: Binomial exact test p-value testing significance against unconditional baseline.

_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Clean Architecture Standard: This JSON file acts exclusively as an empirical Fact Store. It does not contain pre-computed trading directives, adjectival rankings, or heuristic biases. Downstream pure-domain adapters (e.g., entry gates, Bayesian compositors, and allocation rules) consume these objective distributions dynamically to derive execution signals.
